items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: point to Bill Byrne who was the band manager right behind you

ctx.x: What might you have done that Woody Herman would not like, as a drummer?

Well if you weren’t listening, if you weren’t paying attention, if you weren’t swinging the band, you were out of there. I mean Woody was notorious. He would walk right over to where you’re sitting and point to Bill Byrne who was the band manager right behind you and say, “Get me another drummer for tomorrow night.” I mean he could be that cold. If it wasn’t happening he wasn’t going to waste any time you know.

It’s interesting you say that about concentration because that’s not necessarily a given with musicians. You’re playing along and you’re thinking about man I’ve got to get to a laundromat or I haven’t sent my rent check home, and that’s not a good thing.
